pull.title: MINOR: Break down TargetAssignmentBuilderBenchmark by builder
pull.body:
Split the benchmark into separate benchmarks for building the group
spec, the target assignment and the target assignment records. The group
spec is benchmarked both with and without assignor offload, because
offloading copies the group's members and target assignment so that the
assignor can run off the coordinator thread.

Populate a ConsumerGroup and read the members, target assignment and
inverted target assignment from it, instead of plain HashMaps. This
makes the benchmarks iterate over and copy the same TimelineHashMaps as
GroupMetadataManager, which matters most for the offload group spec
benchmark.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
